description: Áreas Prevención Riesgos Desprendimientos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de las Illes Balears. The publisher named on the listing is Gobierno de las Illes Balears. Its keywords include illes balears, esllevissaments, risk prevention areas, balears, risk, área prevenció riscs. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
